name: @ethproofs/zisk-wasm-stark-verifier
description: WASM wrapper for ZisK STARK verifier - verify STARK proofs in browsers and Node.js

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node && rm -f pkg-node/.gitignore
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web && rm -f pkg-web/.gitignore
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:node && npm run build:web
scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f pkg/zisk_wasm_stark_verifier_bg.wasm || { echo 'ERROR: pkg/ is not built - run npm run build first'; exit 1; }

author: Ethproofs
